inventory.item: Revenue = volume × price × mix; Ramu 100 cr cups × ₹5.00 = ₹500 cr
Channel mix: shops 300 (60%), cafés 125 (25%), offices 75 (15%); one-off assumption of ₹4.50 packaged and ₹7.50 café price reproduces 100 cr cups and ₹500 cr
One cup: price 5.00; tea 0.90, milk 1.10, sugar 0.20, cup 0.30, freight 0.25; contribution 2.25 (45%)
Fixed per cup falls with volume; break-even 140 ÷ 2.25 = 62.2 cr cups (Part 8 linked, not re-taught)
Mix shifts move contribution margin more than EBITDA margin when fixed costs follow the mix (cafés higher price and higher fixed costs: one-off assumption)
